description: National Census of Ferry Operators (NCFO) 2018: Vessel data is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Reported 2017 calendar year ferry vessels as surveyed in the 2018 NCFO. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 34 columns, among them CARRIES_PASSENGERS, PASSENGER_CAPACITY, REGISTERED_GROSS_TONS, EXPECTED_LIFESPAN, FUEL_MILEAGE, VEHICLE_CAPACITY. The portal shows 2020-05-05 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
